description.value: This study compared emotion reappraisal and emotion processing at behavioral and neural levels between alcohol-dependent patients and healthy controls using an emotion reappraisal task during functional MRI, with craving measured before and after the task.

spans.text: This study, therefore, compares reappraisal of negative, positive, neutral, and alcohol-related images at a behavioral and neural level between ADPs and healthy controls (HCs).
